en: The image shows a bustling square in an old quarter of a city, with a crowd of people, horse-drawn carts, and buildings featuring late 19th- or early 20th-century European architectural styles. The scene has a historical look, with people wearing period clothing. The postcard has multilingual text in Italian, French, and English at the top left, identifying the location as 'Salonica' (now Thessaloniki), and describes it as a square in the old quarters.
